/** A value as a line of colored tokens, the way a console prints it. */
export interface Token {
  text: string;
  kind?: 'string' | 'number' | 'literal' | 'key';
}

/** Prints `value`; `more` ends a top-level object with `…` (some keys left out). */
export function inspect(value: unknown, more = false): Token[] {
  const out: Token[] = [];
  const print = (item: unknown, ellipsis = false) => {
    if (item === null || item === undefined || typeof item === 'boolean') out.push({ text: String(item), kind: 'literal' });
    else if (typeof item === 'number') out.push({ text: String(Math.round(item)), kind: 'number' });
    else if (typeof item === 'string') out.push({ text: `'${item}'`, kind: 'string' });
    else if (item instanceof Set || Array.isArray(item)) {
      const values = [...item];
      out.push({ text: item instanceof Set ? `Set(${values.length}) { ` : '[' });
      values.forEach((entry, index) => {
        if (index) out.push({ text: ', ' });
        print(entry);
      });
      out.push({ text: item instanceof Set ? ' }' : ']' });
    } else {
      out.push({ text: '{ ' });
      Object.entries(item).forEach(([key, entry], index) => {
        if (index) out.push({ text: ', ' });
        out.push({ text: key, kind: 'key' }, { text: ': ' });
        print(entry);
      });
      out.push({ text: ellipsis ? ', … }' : ' }' });
    }
  };
  print(value, more);
  return out;
}

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { useDnD, type DnDStatus } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import { inspect } from './inspect';

// The provider's drag as reactive state, in a component that drags nothing itself.
const { status, active, over, pointer, activation, selection } = useDnD();

const STATUSES: DnDStatus[] = ['idle', 'activating', 'dragging', 'dropping', 'selecting'];

const rows = computed(() => [
  {
    name: 'active',
    tokens: active.value
      ? inspect({ id: active.value.id, ids: active.value.ids, type: active.value.type, sensor: active.value.sensor }, true)
      : inspect(null),
  },
  { name: 'over', tokens: over.value ? inspect({ id: over.value.id, accepted: over.value.accepted }, true) : inspect(null) },
  { name: 'pointer', tokens: inspect(pointer.value) },
  { name: 'selection.ids', tokens: inspect(selection.ids) },
]);
</script>

<template>
  <section class="inspector" aria-label="useDnD()">
    <header><span class="fn">useDnD</span>()</header>

    <div class="field">
      <span class="name">status</span>
      <ol class="track">
        <li v-for="name in STATUSES" :key="name" :class="{ now: status === name }">{{ name }}</li>
      </ol>
    </div>

    <div class="field">
      <span class="name">activation.progress</span>
      <span class="progress">

    <div v-for="row in rows" :key="row.name" class="field">

      <code :key="row.name === 'pointer' ? row.name : row.tokens.map((token) => token.text).join('')" class="value">

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { makeDroppable, makeSelectionArea, type DnDEvent } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import TokenChip from './TokenChip.vue';

type Place = 'tray' | 'inbox' | 'locked';
const tokens = ref<{ id: string; place: Place; hold?: boolean }[]>([
  { id: 'a', place: 'tray' },
  { id: 'b', place: 'tray' },
  { id: 'c', place: 'tray', hold: true },
]);
const moveTo = (place: Place) => ({ active }: DnDEvent) => {
  for (const token of tokens.value) if (active.ids.includes(token.id)) token.place = place;
};

const tray = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('tray');
const inbox = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('inbox');
const locked = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('locked');
makeDroppable(tray, { id: 'tray', onDrop: moveTo('tray') });
makeDroppable(inbox, { id: 'inbox', onDrop: moveTo('inbox') });
// Refuses everything: `over.accepted` reads false above it.
const { isOver: overLocked } = makeDroppable(locked, { id: 'locked', accept: () => false });
// A band drawn in the tray: `status` reads 'selecting'.
const { isSelecting, style } = makeSelectionArea(tray);
</script>

<template>
  <div class="scene">
    <div ref="tray" class="zone tray">
      <span class="caption">tray</span>
      <TokenChip v-for="token in tokens.filter((item) => item.place === 'tray')" :key="token.id" :token="token" />
      <div v-if="isSelecting" class="band" :style="style" />
    </div>
    <div class="pads">
      <div ref="inbox" class="zone">
        <span class="caption">inbox</span>
        <TokenChip v-for="token in tokens.filter((item) => item.place === 'inbox')" :key="token.id" :token="token" />
      </div>
      <div ref="locked" class="zone locked" :class="{ refusing: overLocked }">
        <span class="caption">locked</span>
